resources.string: Exit (it will not come back by itself)
Auto-start is off on this TV, so the player will not come back by itself: the screen stays off the sign until somebody opens The Display Solution again.

What this app sends to the server, and why, is in the privacy policy:

%1$s

Open it on a phone or a computer.
This TV stops playing and shows a new pairing code. In the dashboard, open Screens and use Replace device to connect it again.
Auto-start is off on this TV. Hold Back for 5 seconds to turn it on.

Auto-start needs the TV to let the player come to the front. A Fire TV allows it once from a computer on the same Wi-Fi:

1. Settings › My Fire TV › About: press OK on the TV's name 7 times.
2. Settings › My Fire TV › Developer Options › ADB Debugging: On.
3. On the computer, run TheDisplaySolution-AutoStart.bat and type this TV's address: %1$s
4. On the TV, tick Always allow and choose OK.
5. When the computer says done, turn ADB Debugging off.

Or with adb: adb connect %1$s, then adb shell appops set %2$s SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW allow

Auto-start needs the TV to let the player come to the front.

Choose Open settings and turn it on for The Display Solution.

A TV without that setting allows it once from a computer on the same Wi-Fi: turn on the TV's developer options and ADB debugging, run TheDisplaySolution-AutoStart.bat on the computer, type this TV's address, %1$s, and allow the computer on the TV.

Or with adb: adb connect %1$s, then adb shell appops set %2$s SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW allow
(connect the TV to the network first)

Android asks once on each TV before an app may install its own updates. On the next screen turn on Allow from this source, then come back here: the update carries on.

This TV keeps the switch elsewhere. In the TV's Settings, let %1$s install unknown apps:

Fire TV: My Fire TV › Developer Options › Install unknown apps. Developer Options appear after pressing OK on the TV's name in Settings › My Fire TV › About 7 times.

Other TVs: Apps, or Privacy › Security and restrictions › Unknown sources.

Then come back to the player: the update carries on by itself. You have 10 minutes before the player comes back to the front.
